entries.name: com.apple.usermanagerhelper

The directory and console services answer the account list read-only.

entries.name: com.apple.deleted_helper
entries.note: bifrostd purges app caches, the thumbnail cache, expired Recently Deleted items (when the Storage policy allows) and old pacman packages (beyond the newest two) when / or /home is low, and on a Free Up Space request; reclaimed bytes and the Purgeable figure are published under /run/bifrost. The Storage policy file (/etc/bifrost/storage.conf) is now written by the privd method storage.policy_set (built 2026-10-17, tests privd::methods::tests). Gaps: apps do not declare cache directories (no manifest key), and the Settings > General > Storage Purgeable line and Free Up Space button are not wired to those files yet.
